tools.name: fulcru_visibility
tools.description: Read the authenticated brand's AI-visibility data (overview, competitors, sources, mentions, prompts).

tools.name: fulcru_gaps
tools.description: List the questions where AI names competitors but not the brand, worst first. Each gap carries a promptId for fulcru_write_page.

tools.name: fulcru_write_page
tools.description: Write the page that closes one gap: a full article draft targeting that query, grounded in the sources AI cites.

tools.name: fulcru_publish_page
tools.description: Mark a drafted page as published at a live URL and snapshot the current AI mention rate as the baseline.

tools.name: fulcru_delta
tools.description: For each published page, the AI mention rate when it went live versus now. The proof the work landed.
